description: Ministry of Trade, Commerce and Food Security - Order Exclude "Liquefied Petroleum Gas" from the List of Specified Goods that was Prescribed by the Gaz. Ex. No. 2287/37 on 08th July, 2022 do this Order Prescribe "Wheat Flour" as Specified good under Section 18 of the Consumer Affairs Authority Act No. 09 of 2003 (Amended) effect from 16th June 2023
reasoning: This gazette content consists of orders made under Section 18 of the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003, which involves regulatory matters. The orders exclude "Liquefied Petroleum gas" from and prescribe "Wheat Flour" as "specified goods" under the Act. This constitutes regulatory framework and compliance requirements, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While a minister's name appears, it is incidental to the regulatory action being taken rather than constituting a personnel appointment or detailed portfolio description that would trigger government classifications (Types 1-3).
